status: Primary-source mechanism reproduced with exact v17 assets; matched original gameplay reversal remains unverified

mechanism: Original ordinary rotation speed is resolved modifier multiplied by4pi radians/sec; modifier1 gives a180-degree reversal in roughly250ms.
Original heading convention is local -Y forward. Exactly +Y with x0 gives heading -pi; exactly -Y gives heading0.
Strict >pi/<-pi wrapping preserves both exact antipodal signs. Alternating those headings traverses -pi/2 on both reversals.
Root motion continues along the current visual facing during that turn, before the late rotation update. A local -Y stride at -pi/2 displaces world -X.
This source mechanism can therefore produce the same lateral arc repeatedly without an added lateral clamp or input bug. Screen-left depends on the camera basis.
